test.run: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq clang >/dev/null && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/carp.zip https://github.com/carp-lang/Carp/releases/download/v0.5.5/carp-v0.5.5-x86_64-linux.zip && unzip -q /tmp/carp.zip -d /tmp && ls /tmp && export CARP_DIR=$(ls -d /tmp/carp-*/) && $CARP_DIR/bin/carp -x HelloWorld.carp
